report_topic: Performance Audit on Functioning of Bengaluru Metropolitan Transport Corporation
observations_summary: The audit found BMTC suffered from operational inefficiencies including unscientific planning, fleet underutilization, and cancellation of services due to staff and vehicle issues. Financially, the corporation incurred increasing operating losses due to non-revision of fares and inadequate government assistance, compounded by delays in maintenance and scrapping of old buses, and underutilization of land assets.
